    Lemma A.1(1) for an arbitrary rooted tree #

    lem:periodic-scalar-gauges (1), periodic-mesh-calculations.tex: "Let Q = ℤΔ/⟨τ^s ρ⟩, where Δ is a finite tree oriented away from a root fixed by ρ. Every nonzero coefficient system c can be changed to the signed preprojective coefficients." Proof: "Label the arrows over a parent-child edge orbit […] Such labels can be assigned recursively down the rooted orbit tree. […] Dividing the two equations gives a recurrence for μ_a. It closes around the cycle exactly when [a product of the η] equals a prescribed number. Choose the root product freely and assign the child products down the tree. Realize each product by one factor, setting the other factors to one."

    The rooted tree is given by a parent map pa reaching the root o (Rooted), and the twist σ fixes o and commutes with pa. For each vertex v ≠ o the edge line {v, pa v} is solved on the representative rep v of the σ-orbit of v, with period per v · c₀, from the relation scales of its parent (step, exists_periodic_line_vertex), and transported along the orbit; the recursion runs on the depth (NM). The solution is g-invariant and solves every edge equation (main). The star version is StarGauge.exists_signed_gauge.

    structure MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.RootedGauge.Rooted (D : Type u_1) :
    Type u_1

    A rooted tree with a twist: a parent map reaching the root o, and a permutation σ fixing the root and commuting with the parent map.

    • o : D
    • pa : D → D
    • root (v : D) : ∃ (n : ℕ), self.pa^[n] v = self.o
    • σ : Equiv.Perm D
    • σ_o : self.σ self.o = self.o
    • σ_pa (v : D) : self.σ (self.pa v) = self.pa (self.σ v)
